newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Retail tycoon buys Multipolar stake.
newsitem.headline: Retail tycoon buys Multipolar stake.

text.p: Indonesian PT Multipolar Corporation said retail tycoon Hari Dharmawan has bought a 10-percent stake in Multipolar.

"Hari Dharmawan in his personal capacity through his personal holding company PT Haritama Bakti Persada has purchased 10 percent of Multipolar shares for 56 billion rupiah or 2,025 rupiah per share from Lippo Group," retailer Multipolar said in a statement received on Thursday.
Hari Dharmawan is president and founder of Matahari, one of Indonesia's largest retailers.
Dharmawan bought the first five-percent stake, or 13,713,500 shares, at 2,025 rupiah per share for 27.8 billion rupiah through a cross trade by Lippo Securities on Wednesday, it said.
The second five-percent purchase was expected to be completed within two weeks, Multipolar said.
Dharmawan said in the statement that he had indicated he would make the purchase since December last year.
"It is also my hope to be able to increase my shareholding of Multipolar through further share purchases as and when appropriate," Dharmawan said in the statement.
Multipolar, a member of the Lippo Group conglomerate, has a controlling stake in Matahari.
